provenance: Hand-transcribed 2026-07-25 at the N2-T03 derivation (docs/design/2026-07-25-n2-t03-derivation.md), exactly as the N2-T02a citation manifest was hand-transcribed before it. Every entry names the file and line where the record states the claim, and reproduces the record's own wording in as_written. No entry is invented; no figure is normalised beyond the German decimal comma becoming a dot in the machine-checkable tokens. Scope is Record I only (13 of the 21 manifest citations): it is the record the capability roadmap's staging rests on and the place where the 40-80 misattribution originates. Records II and III follow as N2-T03d once the shape has carried real material.
excerpt_note: Every status this manifest can receive is relative to the CHECKED EXCERPT, which for N2-T03 is the source ABSTRACT (arXiv Atom summary, or the Crossref abstract for the Nature DOI) and nothing else. Absence from an abstract is not refutation — it is the normal case, measured at derivation at roughly 28 percent figure coverage. Contradiction is NOT decidable against an abstract and is therefore not in this packet's vocabulary at all; it is deferred, named, to N2-T03c.
note_on_exclusions: Three claims of Record I are deliberately excluded and the reason is named rather than silent: (1) the Agent-Laboratory NeurIPS scores '4,0/10 vs. 5,9' (line 152) are marked REFUTED by the record itself and must not be used; (2) the '600+ Desk-Rejects wegen fabrizierter Referenzen bei ICLR 2026' (line 80) is attributed in the record's own sentence to ICLR, not unambiguously to arXiv 2605.29468 — binding it to that citation would be an attribution WE invent; (3) '100 fabrizierte Referenzen in bereits akzeptierten NeurIPS-2025-Papers' (line 60) is credited to a GPTZero scan with the Ansari taxonomy cited only for the taxonomy, so the figure does not belong to arXiv 2602.05930 either. Exclusions are entries here with kind 'excluded', never omissions.

anchor_note: Every figure claim carries anchor_terms: lower-case substrings that must ALL occur in the checked excerpt within anchor_window_chars of the matched number, or the claim counts as absent. They exist because a bare numeric comparison produced 3 FALSE SUPPORTS out of 14 at the derivation: '6' matched the JATS reference marker '6,7' in the Nature abstract, '1' and '3' matched '1,2' and '3-5', and Agent Laboratory's 'three stages' matched the enumeration '(3) Human involvement'. Certifying support that does not exist is the exact failure this whole audit is built to prevent, so token presence alone is NOT a status this packet can emit. The terms are authored from what the RECORD claims the quantity is, never from the source text — anchoring them to wording found in the abstract would tune the check towards confirming.
anchor_window_note: 60 characters, chosen from a sweep run at the derivation over 200/120/80/60/40/25. The outcome is identical from 200 down to 60 and first changes at 40, where Kosmos's '79.4% of statements ... to be accurate' drops out: exactly 40 characters separate the figure from its anchor there, and that is the binding case — which is precisely why the sweep flips at 40. (This note first said 47: a distance estimated off a context printout at the derivation and then stated as measured. Corrected 2026-07-25 at the review, after the builder flagged the discrepancy; the two independently fetched abstracts are bit-identical, so no source revision was involved. No status is affected, since 40 < 60. The error is exactly the form this manifest exists to catch, committed in the manifest's own derivation — recorded here rather than quietly overwritten.) 60 is therefore the SMALLEST window at which every genuinely supported claim in this set still resolves — narrower trades a coincidental match for a false absence, wider only adds coincidence. KNOWN LIMIT, named rather than tuned away: at 60 'agent-laboratory-stages' resolves through a coincidental neighbourhood — the digit 3 matched the enumeration item '(3) Human involvement ... at each stage', not the abstract's real support, which is spelled out as the WORD 'three stages'. The verdict is right, the rendered evidence is not. No window setting can tell a describing neighbour from an accidental one, which is why rendering the matched window in the report is MANDATORY and not optional: a reader must be able to see a coincidence. Figures are matched as DIGITS only — a source that spells a number as a word counts as absent, and absent is not refutation.
quotation_similarity_threshold_note: 0.75 is a BUILD DECISION, not a swept value like anchor_window_chars: no claim in this manifest's acceptance oracle ever resolves to quotation_altered (0 of 4 quotation claims), so there is no real case to calibrate a threshold against. Checked instead against the real committed corpus at build time: a normalised (lower-cased, whitespace-collapsed) difflib.SequenceMatcher ratio over a word-length window slid across the checked excerpt, best ratio taken. The closest UNRELATED pairing in this corpus — aar-inference-chain-transient's quoted sentence against the AAR abstract's own unrelated 'transient constraints'/'unverifiable inference' phrasing, which shares two content words with the quote by coincidence — scores approximately 0.45, well clear of this threshold. An exact match is caught earlier regardless (quotation_verbatim, checked first, never reaches this comparison), so 0.75 only ever governs a genuine near-paraphrase. Pinned here, hashed and gated exactly like anchor_window_chars, because it is the ONLY parameter in this packet's vocabulary that can produce a VIOLATION (quotation_altered) rather than an observation — unlike anchor_window_chars it has no sweep behind it, so it must not be free to drift silently in a module constant a code change could shift without any anchor noticing.
